# go-slim.dev/h3

> A small, standard-library-first Go HTTP application foundation with declarative routing, middleware composition, component lifecycle management, HTTP/HTTPS startup, custom routing fallbacks, and response metadata.

Import path: `go-slim.dev/h3`. Requires Go 1.25.5 or later. Runtime code depends only on the Go standard library.

Use `Router` to declare routes, middleware, and mounted sub-routers. Call `Router.Build` to atomically publish an immutable `http.ServeMux` snapshot, or use `App`, whose `Start` method builds the root Router automatically. Use `Component` and `Servlet` for modular routes and ordered resource lifecycle. Use `NewResponse` only when final response status, size, or commit metadata is needed outside App.

Important behavior:

- Route patterns and matching retain Go 1.22+ `http.ServeMux` semantics, including methods, hosts, wildcards, path values, redirects, and GET/HEAD behavior.
- Router configuration is intentionally single-writer and not concurrency-safe. Published routing snapshots serve concurrent requests without locks.
- `Use`, `Handle`, `HandleFunc`, and `Mount` only change declarations. Changes become visible after the next `Build`.
- Mounted routes are expanded at build time, so handlers keep the original URL and `Request.Pattern` contains every mount prefix.
- Middleware factories run during `Build` or `CompileRoutes`, once per final route per compilation, never during request dispatch.
- App lifecycle operations are sequential and lock-free. Do not call `Start`, `Stop`, `Register`, or `Run` concurrently.
- The Context passed to `Start` controls startup and rollback. Cancelling it after a successful start does not stop the running App; call `Stop` explicitly.
- `Options.NotFound` and `Options.MethodNotAllowed` replace only routing-layer 404/405 responses. A matched handler's own 404/405 response is unchanged, and custom 405 handlers receive the standard `Allow` header.
- App wraps writers as `h3.Response`; standalone Router does not. Response records one final status and body size, not interim 1xx responses or writes performed through `Unwrap`.
- h3 intentionally does not provide binding, rendering, validation, content negotiation, tracing, a custom request Context, or a central error pipeline.

## Documentation

- [English README](https://github.com/go-slim/h3/blob/main/README.md): Design principles, routing, lifecycle, fallbacks, TLS, Response, and examples.
- [Chinese README](https://github.com/go-slim/h3/blob/main/README_CN.md): 中文设计说明、路由、生命周期、错误回退、TLS 与响应元数据文档。
- [Go package reference](https://pkg.go.dev/go-slim.dev/h3): Generated GoDoc for the exported API.
- [Full LLM context](https://github.com/go-slim/h3/blob/main/llms-full.txt): Self-contained API, lifecycle, concurrency, routing, fallback, and Response reference.

## Source

- [Router](https://github.com/go-slim/h3/blob/main/router.go): Route declarations, middleware, mounts, pattern expansion, compilation, atomic publication, and duplicate policy.
- [App](https://github.com/go-slim/h3/blob/main/app.go): Server options, route entry point, components, listener creation, HTTP/HTTPS serving, startup rollback, and shutdown.
- [Route fallbacks](https://github.com/go-slim/h3/blob/main/route_fallback.go): Optional routing-layer 404/405 replacement while preserving `http.ServeMux` matching and `Allow`.
- [Response](https://github.com/go-slim/h3/blob/main/response.go): Final status, body size, commit tracking, unwrapping, flush, hijack, and push delegation.
- [Component](https://github.com/go-slim/h3/blob/main/component.go): Mountable route modules.
- [Servlet](https://github.com/go-slim/h3/blob/main/servlet.go): Ordered startup and shutdown contract.
- [Run and internal helpers](https://github.com/go-slim/h3/blob/main/util.go): Blocking `Run`, panic-to-error lifecycle calls, atomic Router loading, and TLS validation.

## Tests

- [Router tests](https://github.com/go-slim/h3/blob/main/router_test.go): Build publication, middleware order, duplicate replacement, host patterns, mounts, cycles, and standard routing behavior.
- [App tests](https://github.com/go-slim/h3/blob/main/app_test.go): Listener errors, TLS, restart, Context semantics, components, lifecycle rollback, stop order, and callbacks.
- [Fallback tests](https://github.com/go-slim/h3/blob/main/route_fallback_test.go): Custom/default 404 and 405 behavior, `Allow`, matched-route status preservation, and redirects.
- [Response tests](https://github.com/go-slim/h3/blob/main/response_test.go): Metadata, idempotent wrapping, optional interfaces, and unsupported operations.
- [Run tests](https://github.com/go-slim/h3/blob/main/util_test.go): Blocking completion, callback preservation, and final error propagation.

## Related packages and standards

- [go-slim.dev/binding](https://github.com/go-slim/binding): Request input binding for `*http.Request`.
- [go-slim.dev/middleware](https://github.com/go-slim/middleware): Standard `net/http` middleware.
- [go-slim.dev/nego](https://github.com/go-slim/nego): Content-Type matching and HTTP content negotiation.
- [Go `http.ServeMux`](https://pkg.go.dev/net/http#ServeMux): Authoritative route-pattern and matching semantics.
- [Go `http.Server`](https://pkg.go.dev/net/http#Server): Authoritative server option and shutdown semantics.
